## Reproducible notebooks

Both notebooks are in the repository under `notebooks/` with outputs stripped. They are the end-user pattern: one `pip install` cell, then ordinary cells.

| Notebook | What it runs | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 18: Qwen2.5 on T4 | Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct TP=1 (plain cells), then Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with TP=2 and with PP=2 | [notebooks/18_stokastisk_qwen25_t4.ipynb](https://github.com/stokastisk-ai/stokastisk/blob/387c414295fbd65e6c93099c58dfeee43c3ce3fc/notebooks/18_stokastisk_qwen25_t4.ipynb) |
| 19: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B | the original unquantized FP16 checkpoint with TP=2, then PP=2, one Python-coding prompt each | [notebooks/19_stokastisk_qwen25_coder_7b_dual_t4.ipynb](https://github.com/stokastisk-ai/stokastisk/blob/387c414295fbd65e6c93099c58dfeee43c3ce3fc/notebooks/19_stokastisk_qwen25_coder_7b_dual_t4.ipynb) |

Run each from the top in a fresh Kaggle session (GPU T4 × 2, Internet ON). They are not throughput benchmarks; on two PCIe-connected T4s TP=1 is fastest for any model that fits one card. Their install cell installs **build 5**; the recorded outputs came from build 3.

## What was executed, and on which build

| Notebook | Date | What ran | Recorded result | Build |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15: acceptance suite (maintainers) | 2026-11-13 | full GPU suite on a locally built bundle | installer 32/32, static 79/79, engine 44/44, parallel 23/23, server 21/21, summary 15/15 | 3 (acceptance wheel) |
| 16: quickstart | 2026-11-13 | `pip install` from the published index and a `demo.py` script | `TRITON_ATTN`; completion, chat, structured JSON; clean shutdown | 3 |
| 18: Qwen2.5, plain cells | 2026-11-14 | 0.5B-Instruct TP=1; 3B-Instruct TP=2; 3B-Instruct PP=2 | all generated; `TRITON_ATTN`; GPUs released (14.46 of 14.56 GiB free) | 3 |
| 19: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct | 2026-11-14 | original FP16 checkpoint, TP=2 then PP=2 | both generated; `TRITON_ATTN`; GPUs released | 3 |

Environment of those runs: Kaggle 2 × Tesla T4, Python 3.13.16, PyTorch 2.11.0+cu130, Triton 3.6.0, CUDA 13.0.

::: {.callout-important}
## Build 3 was tested, build 5 is current
Builds 4 and 5 were **not** run on Kaggle. Build 5 differs from build 3 only in compatibility reporting and one error message; the audits prove the vLLM tree, native binaries, dependency pins and executable SDK code unchanged, so the build-3 evidence is **inherited** for those paths. See [Release verification](release-verification.qmd).
:::

## What the notebook 15 stages proved

| Stage | Proves |
|---|---|
| installer | protected packages untouched; hash-pinned locks installed with `--no-deps --no-index`; no new `pip check` line; feature imports; installed tree has 0 Flash files |
| static | configuration, compatibility and serving validation; backend registry on SM7.5; Flash import guard; dependency completeness; CPU structured-output stack |
| engine | FP16 generate, chat and complete; determinism; input validation; pinned-xgrammar structured output; serialisation and timeout; `TRITON_ATTN` in config and as a compiled kernel; no Flash library; close and cleanup |
| parallel | TP=2, PP=2 (experimental) and `ReplicaPool`: real generation, both GPUs engaged, clean shutdown, memory released; topology and recommender |
| server | `vllm serve` start and ready, models, chat, streaming, HTTP errors, structured output over HTTP, metrics, startup-failure report, port check, restart, graceful shutdown |
| summary | all stages describe the same wheel and runtime; a missing report is `NOT_RUN`; only `PASS` passes |

The harness that produced these reports is no longer part of the repository; the raw reports, logs and executed notebooks are archived under `evidence/kaggle/` and indexed with SHA256 values in `evidence/kaggle/evidence-manifest.json`. Two original output archives (about 17 MB, mostly Triton caches) are not in the repository; their hashes are in the manifest.

Result vocabulary: `PASS`, `FAIL`, `ERROR`, `WARNING`, `SKIPPED`, `NOT_RUN`. Only `PASS` passes.

## Memory readings recorded

| Run | Free GiB per GPU during inference | Free GiB after `close()` |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, TP=2 | about 1.09 | 14.46 of 14.56 |
| Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, PP=2 | 1.96 and 1.48 | 14.46 of 14.56 |
| Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, TP=2 | about 1.34 | 14.46 of 14.56 |
| Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, PP=2 | 2.42 and 1.93 | 14.46 of 14.56 |

All with `max_model_len=2048`, `gpu_memory_utilization=0.88`, one prompt. These are single measurements, not benchmarks and not a promise for other models.
